key.description: Whether hooks can filter which tools or events they respond to using name matching, regex patterns, or structured criteria.

matcher_patterns.mechanism: per-tool input matching documented under 'Match Conditions' / 'Regular Expression Patterns' headings (hook_match_input_contains)

key.description: Whether hooks can make or influence permission decisions determining whether a tool is available for invocation. Minimum qualification: supported when the provider allows hooks to return permission decisions of any kind (grant, deny, or ask). Boundary: permission_control governs whether a tool is available; see decision_control for invocation-flow control.

permission_control.mechanism: hooks integrate with amp's permission system to control tool availability (documented under 'How Permissions Work' / 'Add Rules' headings)

key.description: Whether the provider supports organization-level MCP configuration management, including managed server lists, allowlists, and enterprise registries.

enterprise_management.mechanism: workspace-admin-enforced MCP registry with allowlist documented under 'MCP Registry Allowlist' heading (modelcontextprotocol.io schema; unreachable registry blocks all servers)

key.description: Whether the provider supports OAuth 2.0 authentication for remote MCP servers, including token storage and automatic refresh.

oauth_support.mechanism: OAuth 2.0 authentication for remote MCP servers documented under 'OAuth for Remote MCP Servers' heading

key.description: Which per-server tool filtering mechanisms the provider supports. Contents: {allowlist: bool, blocklist: bool, disable_flag: bool}. Controls which server tools are exposed to the agent. Boundary: tool_filtering governs tool visibility (what appears in the agent's available tool set); see auto_approve for execution gating of visible tools.

tool_filtering.mechanism: per-tool enable/disable documented under '3. Configure Tool Access' heading (VS Code UI exposes individual tool toggles within each configured server)

always.mechanism: AGENTS.md files are always_on within their scope (cwd, parent dirs, subtrees) — documented under 'AGENTS.md' / 'Writing AGENTS.md Files'

glob.mechanism: @-mentioned files use 'globs' frontmatter for selective activation (documented under 'Granular Guidance'); globs implicitly prefixed with **/ unless ../ or ./

key.description: How rules decide when to load into context. Providers implement varying modes: always-on, conditional/glob-based, model-decision, and manual activation. Tracks which modes the provider supports and how they are configured.
key.spec_ref: ACIF-RULE §9.1 (DERIVABLE); activation-mode vocabulary ACIF-RULE Appendix A, §10

agents_md.mechanism: native AGENTS.md format; 'Migrating to AGENTS.md' documents one-time mv+symlink from CLAUDE.md and .cursorrules

key.description: Which rule file formats from other providers this provider recognizes. Contents: recognized_formats (list of filenames like AGENTS.md, .cursorrules, .windsurfrules). Minimum qualification: supported when the provider reads at least one rule-file format defined by a different provider.
Whether rules can reference or include content from other files. Mechanisms vary: @-import syntax, @file.md directives, @path/to/file references.
key.spec_ref: ACIF-RULE §9.2 (OUT-OF-SCOPE-AT-L1; strongest requires candidate — see ACIF ROADMAP, body-content reference grammar)

file_imports.mechanism: @-mention syntax includes other files as context — supports relative, absolute, and ~/ paths (documented under 'Granular Guidance')

key.description: Whether rules load from multiple directory levels with defined precedence. Enables project-root rules plus subdirectory-scoped overrides.

hierarchical_loading.mechanism: three-tier scope: AGENTS.md in cwd + parent dirs + subtrees + personal global at $HOME/.config/amp/AGENTS.md (documented under 'Writing AGENTS.md Files'); subtree loading is unique to amp

key.description: The required or conventional filename for this skill type. For example, "SKILL.md" for Claude Code skills.
Whether the skill can be installed at global/personal scope (applies across all projects for the current user).
Whether the skill can be installed at project scope (applies to current project only, typically committed to version control).

project_scope.mechanism: skill directory placed under .agents/skills/<name>/ or .claude/skills/<name>/ within the project root

skills.executable_tools.mechanism: documented under 'Executable Tools in Skills' heading

skills.mcp_integration.mechanism: documented under 'MCP Servers in Skills' heading
